column14: The first sign-in through a provider decides whose account it is, in this order: an account already linked to that subject signs its user in; a `WithResolveUser` decision to link names the user; an existing user with the same email is linked only when the provider is trusted (a default provider, a domain-verified one, or one `TrustProviders` names), the address is in one of the provider's domains, and the local address is verified, and otherwise the sign-in is refused with `409 sso.account_exists`; anyone else gets a new account ([the rule in code](ds:block?id=plugin-resolve-y5d3hvbs)).
